note: Subject layer of variant A of the robed cultists' round 2 (bead pulp_wars-mch9.54): fresh creations of ordinary people with visible faces, evil in their robes and props. Exploration only.

subjects.UNIT:CULT:FIGHTER/BLOOD: Subject: Initiate, a chunky shifty young man, a novice of an evil secret society and the smallest figure: a plain deep blood-red hooded robe with a black rope belt and a ragged pointed hem down to his black boots; the hood is up but his pale human face is clearly visible, with narrow suspicious eyes, a nasty smirk and dark stubble; one hand raises a curved sacrificial dagger whose steel blade is smeared with bright red blood, the other holds a short cream candle with a small green flame; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.UNIT:CULT:GUARD/BLOOD: Subject: Idol Bearer, a chunky stout broad-shouldered bald man with a heavy grim scowling face, the widest and squarest figure: a long black robe with a deep blood-red stole embroidered with gold sigils and an iron chain round the waist; both arms are raised and hold over his head one squat pale grey stone idol head as big as his own head, with a wide evil toothy grin and two small green eyes; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.UNIT:CULT:MARKSMAN/BLOOD: Subject: Hexer, a chunky sly woman of an evil secret society: a long blood-red robe embroidered with gold occult sigils and a deep purple cowl over her dark hair, her pale face clearly visible with a cruel smug smile and narrowed eyes; one hand holds up an open black-bound ritual book, the other hand is thrust forward with one small green spark of a curse leaving her fingers; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.UNIT:CULT:CAPTAIN/BLOOD: Subject: Summoner, the high priest of an evil secret society, the tallest and thinnest figure: a narrow ornate ceremonial robe of deep blood red and black with a gold embroidered collar of sigils and a very tall pointed blood-red cowl; his gaunt face is pallid grey-white with dark veins round the eyes and one milky white eye; one hand raises a long ornate ritual dagger, its steel blade dripping bright red blood, and a black iron chain hangs from the other hand; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.UNIT:CULT:CATAPULT/BLOOD: Subject: Stargazer, a crooked old astrologer of an evil secret society at a big brass telescope: a long black robe embroidered with gold stars and a blood-red hood; his wrinkled pale face is pressed to the eyepiece of one fat polished brass telescope on a wooden tripod, the tube pointing up to the right; a cream star chart scroll trails on the ground; the telescope glass is dark, not glowing; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.PORTRAIT:CULT:FIGHTER/BLOOD: Subject: Initiate portrait, head and shoulders of a chunky shifty bearded man of an evil secret society: a deep blood-red hood with gold trim up over his head, his pale human face clearly visible with narrow mean eyes, a nasty toothy grin and a short dark beard, blood-red robe shoulders, a small green glowing amulet on his chest, and one curved sacrificial dagger with bright red blood on its steel blade held up beside his face; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.PORTRAIT:CULT:GUARD/BLOOD: Subject: Idol Bearer portrait, head and shoulders of a chunky stout bald man of an evil secret society with a heavy grim scowl and grey stubble, black robe shoulders with a blood-red and gold stole, and resting on top of his bald head, held by his two hands, a squat pale grey stone idol head with a wide evil toothy grin and two small green eyes; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.PORTRAIT:CULT:MARKSMAN/BLOOD: Subject: Hexer portrait, head and shoulders of a chunky sly woman of an evil secret society: a deep purple hood with gold trim over her dark hair, her pale face clearly visible with narrowed cruel eyes and a thin smug sneer, blood-red robe shoulders embroidered with gold, and one hand raised beside her face with a small green spark of a curse above the fingers; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.PORTRAIT:CULT:CAPTAIN/BLOOD: Subject: Summoner portrait, head and shoulders of the gaunt high priest of an evil secret society: a very tall pointed blood-red cowl with gold trim reaching the top of the image, his living face pallid grey-white with dark veins round the eyes, one dark eye and one milky white eye, a nose and a thin cruel mouth, a black and gold collar, and a ritual dagger with bright red blood on its steel blade held up beside his face; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.PORTRAIT:CULT:CATAPULT/BLOOD: Subject: Stargazer portrait, head and shoulders of a crooked old astrologer of an evil secret society: a floppy blood-red hood with gold trim, a wrinkled pale face with bushy white eyebrows, a white beard and one eye squinting, red and black robe shoulders, and beside his face the eyepiece end of one fat polished brass telescope pointing up to the right; simple shapes and very few details.
